label: Buffers needed at the fast corner
section: Buffers needed at the fast corner
subgoals: Read the hold violation at the fast corner
Divide it by the fast-corner buffer delay
Round up to get the number of buffers

label: Setup cost at the slow corner
section: Setup cost at the slow corner
subgoals: Multiply the number of buffers by the slow-corner buffer delay
Subtract it from the slow-corner setup slack
Compare the setup cost with the hold gain

label: The feasibility bound
subgoals: Divide the setup slack by the slow-corner buffer delay
Round down to get the maximum number of buffers
Compare it with the number needed to decide whether buffering is feasible
